response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile full-stack engineer (15+ years) with genuine systems-level depth in low-latency services and some infrastructure/DevOps ownership, plus strong community teaching and open-source leadership. However, the role's hardest requirement — 8 years of C++ — is not met; his documented C/C++ work amounts to roughly 7 months at National Instruments plus a university thesis, with the bulk of his career in TypeScript/Node.js and D. He also lacks production cloud-platform architecture at scale and any formal technical leadership role mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers. Strong generalist, but a poor match for a C++-centric compute platform lead position.
strengths: Low-latency, high-throughput microservices experience at Sociomantic (millions of req/s)
Proven mentoring and knowledge-sharing via workshops, courses, and conference talks
Broad polyglot systems background including embedded, DevOps/CI, and Kubernetes deployment
concerns: C++ experience far below the 8-year minimum (~1 year total)
No formal technical leadership or team-lead role on the resume
Limited large-scale cloud compute platform architecture ownership

key_factors.factor: Absence of formal technical leadership role
